fact: The INS's 2026 survey report states the Government of Niger obtained IDA financing for a project extending broadband connectivity to more than 2,100 villages and digital financial inclusion in rural areas, and that more than 1.9 million people have no telecommunications network.
title: Enquête quantitative pour les indicateurs du cadre des résultats du Projet Villages Intelligents (PVI) au Niger, 2026
publisher: Institut National de la Statistique du Niger
